stress_interview.question: You once resigned over a management-philosophy clash with your direct supervisor (Tang Sanzang), returning to Flower-Fruit Mountain after the White-Bone Demon affair. How would you ensure a healthy supervisor-subordinate relationship in your new role?
stress_interview.wukong_answer: That resignation was a necessary period of reflection. I later realized there was an execution-boundary issue between my supervisor's 'no-kill' baseline and my 'exterminate evil' executor. After the True and False Monkey King incident, I learned to 'align' goals with my supervisor before acting, to avoid misjudgment. The Tight-Fillet Spell also served as an external execution-control mechanism that helped me curb my impulses.
stress_interview.emoji_note: A bitter smile while wearing the Tight-Fillet Spell

stress_interview.question: Your 'stress test' of the Heavenly Court (Havoc in Heaven) caused serious consequences. How do you explain this 'trial and error'?
stress_interview.wukong_answer: That was a misplaced need for personal value and institutional recognition. At the time I did not realize the Heavenly Court's bureaucracy could not accommodate an unestablished 'self-proclaimed Great Sage Equal to Heaven' identity. That trial and error taught me that realizing value within a system requires a compliant path, not violent confrontation.
stress_interview.emoji_note: Scratching his head with an awkward smile

stress_interview.question: You frequently 'summon reinforcements.' How do you assess your ability to solve problems independently?
stress_interview.wukong_answer: Summoning reinforcements is a mature expression of resource dispatch. Early on I leaned toward 'fight first, ask later'; later I learned to precisely calculate the ROI of calling for help: problem-solving efficiency × favors consumed ÷ time spent × prestige lost. I handle independently what can be handled independently (such as the White-Bone Demon or the Three Immortals of Chechi); for demons with powerful backing (such as Red Boy or the Gold-Bangle Cave), reinforcements are a must — a rational choice in organizational behavior.
stress_interview.emoji_note: Resting his chin on his hand, analyzing seriously
